lines.en: : In a roundabout way, the horrible portion of your advice actually helped me figure something out!
lines.zh: : 绕了一圈，你那建议里糟糕的那部分反倒让我想明白了一件事！

lines.en: : Was that your goal all along?
lines.zh: : 你从一开始就是这个目的吧？

lines.en: I actually thought that advice was pretty good.
lines.zh: 其实我觉得那建议挺好的。

lines.en: : Yup. You got me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你抓到我了。

lines.en: : Talk to Makoto and let me know how it goes.
lines.zh: : 跟 Makoto 谈谈，然后告诉我结果。

lines.en: : Will do!
lines.zh: : 一定！

lines.en: : It’s time for Maki Miyamura’s Mom-Mode Mission!
lines.zh: : 现在是 Maki Miyamura 的妈妈模式任务时间！

lines.en: : Like that alliteration, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喜欢这个头韵吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I learned what that word means from my daughter. She’s so smart, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 那个词是我女儿教我的。她可真聪明，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes, Maki.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Maki。

lines.en: : She’s brilliant.
lines.zh: : 她很聪明。

lines.en: scene black
The conversation gradually drifts back into normal territory and, before long, Maki and I are conversing about sex positions and famous porn-stars.
lines.zh: 对话渐渐漂回了「正常」的范畴，没过多久，我和 Maki 就在聊性爱体位和著名的色情片演员了。

lines.en: It’s slightly odd counting those two things as “Normal territory” but, with a girl like her, there isn’t much {i}abnormal{/i} territory.
lines.zh: 把这两样东西算作「正常范畴」是有点怪，不过跟她这样的女人在一起，本来也没什么{i}不正常{/i}的范畴。

lines.en: I do hope she’s able to coax Makoto out of her shell soon, though.
lines.zh: 不过我真心希望她能尽快把 Makoto 从壳里哄出来。

lines.en: I haven’t exactly noticed her acting any differently other than the walk back to her dorm after we went up to the roof, but...
lines.zh: 除了那次我们上了天台之后回宿舍的路上，我倒没怎么察觉她有什么异样，不过……

lines.en: That just seemed entirely random.
lines.zh: 那看起来完全是随机的。

lines.en: Maybe it would be worth asking her about it myself?
lines.zh: 也许我自己去问问她会比较好？
